MARITAL SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT

This Marital Settlement Agreement is entered into on 5 October 2026 between Rahul Verma ("Husband") and Anita Verma ("Wife"), who were married on 12 February 2015 and have one minor child, Aarav Verma, born 3 March 2018.

1. SEPARATION
The parties have lived separately since 1 June 2026 and agree to seek a divorce by mutual consent.

2. CHILD CUSTODY
The Wife shall have primary physical custody of the minor child. The Husband shall have visitation on alternate weekends.

3. PROPERTY
The flat at 22 Hill Road, Pune shall be transferred to the Wife. The Husband shall retain the car.

4. SPOUSAL MAINTENANCE
The Husband shall pay the Wife a one-time settlement of Rs. 15,00,000 within ninety (90) days of the divorce decree. The Wife waives all future claims to maintenance.

5. DEBTS
Each party shall be responsible for debts in their own name.

6. SERVICES OF COUNSEL
Each party has had the opportunity to obtain independent legal services before signing this agreement.
